note: Model advice for the Level up step. One place to correct names and versions: entries marked verify were written from the product owner's wording and not checked against the vendors.

capabilities.title: Images
capabilities.blurb: Codex can generate images and they land in Changes as artifacts. For the fastest loop, ask a text model for SVG.

picks.name: OpenAI's newest image model ("2.5 flare")
picks.why: Best quality today. Reached through a Codex agent signed in with OpenAI.

picks.name: OpenAI's default text model, SVG only
picks.why: Near-realtime: the SVG streams in and you watch the picture draw itself. Great for logos, icons, diagrams.
picks.tip: Draw a minimalist fox logo as a single SVG. Output SVG code only, no commentary.

picks.name: Gemini image generation
picks.why: Good, not as strong as OpenAI's.

picks.name: Grok images (via OpenRouter)
picks.why: Good, not as strong as OpenAI's.

picks.name: Claude
picks.why: Claude does not generate images. It can still write SVG and code, so use it for those.

capabilities.title: Voice
capabilities.blurb: Codly's own dictation uses Groq Whisper (set it up in Settings). For live voice conversations, use a realtime model.

picks.name: OpenAI Realtime 2.1
picks.why: The best realtime voice: speech in, speech out over a live connection.

picks.name: Gemini realtime voice
picks.why: Google has a realtime version too.

picks.name: Grok realtime voice
picks.why: xAI has a realtime version too.

picks.name: Groq Whisper dictation (built into Codly)
picks.why: Hold ⌥ in the composer and talk; the text lands in your draft. Free key at console.groq.com.

capabilities.title: Video
capabilities.blurb: Video models run on their vendors' sites and APIs; agents can script them. Pick by look and price.

steps.title: Install OpenCode
steps.body: OpenCode is the CLI that talks to hundreds of models. Install it from the crew step, or run `npm install -g opencode-ai@latest`.

steps.title: Get an OpenRouter key
steps.body: OpenRouter is one account and one key for almost every model (Claude, GPT, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi…). Create one at openrouter.ai/keys and add a few dollars of credit.

steps.title: Paste it here
steps.body: Codly keeps it in your Mac's Keychain and hands it to OpenCode only. Claude Code, Codex and Gemini never see it.

brains.local: Prefer to run models on your own machine? Install Ollama or LM Studio, pull a model (for example `ollama pull qwen3-coder`), and point OpenCode at it with its base URL.

missions.title: Tour this repo
missions.text: Read this repository and give me a short tour: what it does, how it is organised, and the three files I should read first. Don't change anything.

missions.title: Draw a logo (SVG)
missions.text: Draw a simple, memorable logo for this project as a single SVG. Output SVG code only, save it as logo.svg, and show it to me.
